label: Threads
what: Your latest Threads posts and how they did.

credentials.label: Threads access token
credentials.help: A long-lived user access token from Meta for Developers.
credentials.looks: A long string of letters and numbers

reads: Your own latest posts: text, time and link.
Where Meta allows it, the counts for each: views, likes, replies, reposts and quotes.
not_reads: Your followers, your messages and your account settings.
scopes: threads_manage_insights (for the counts; without it posts show without numbers)
steps: At developers.facebook.com create an app and add the Threads use case.
Add your own Threads account as a tester of the app and accept the invitation in Threads.
Generate a user access token for your account with threads_basic and threads_manage_insights.
Exchange the short-lived token for a long-lived one. A long-lived token lasts about 60 days and can be refreshed before it ends.
Enter the token here and save it. Then switch Threads on.
Come back before it expires and enter a new one. The page says when the token has expired.
revoke: In Threads open Settings, then Account, then Website permissions, and remove the app. Then remove the token here.
tested: Parsing tested against sample data only. The shape of the counts answer is not confirmed. Not tested against the real service.
